sections.title: Markov, Chebyshev, Hoeffding and dependent-sampling concentration

missing_pieces.duty: assessment_dispute: ED26-P15-CH-bounded-concentration-learning-C008 (partial): the route covers the Theorem-1 half of Hoeffding 1963 p.15 n.4. That half is the Markov attainment mu/(mu+t) without an upper range at handbook/parts/p15/bounded-concentration-learning.tex 239-241, and the (e^{hS}-1)/(e^{hA}-1) refinement at 242-251, with proofs at annex 363-387. The same footnote's Theorem-3 sentence is not on the route: it says X_i<=b is crucial to any improvement over the Chebyshev bound (1.6). A search of parts/annex p15 finds no statement, witness or proof of it. Supply it with a written proof and cite p.~15 n.~4. One witness: independent centered summands of average variance sigma^2 with no upper bound that attain sigma^2/(sigma^2+nt^2).
